Detect Closers

Detect closers using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

detect_closers(text)

Example input

{
  "text": "Done. Hope this helps!"
}

Example output

[
  "hope this helps"
]

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py detect_closers < examples/detect-closers.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
